dedupe_keys.name: geer lidar data from the 2023 kahramanmaras earthquake sequence reconnaissance

description: GEER Lidar Data from the 2023 Kahramanmaras Earthquake Sequence Reconnaissance is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "field recon", published or maintained by Diane Moug, Portland State University (pdx.edu). This data was gathered during the Geotechnical Extreme Events Reconnaissance (GEER) efforts following the February 6, 2023, Kahramanmaraş earthquake sequence. This dataset is comprised of terrestrial lidar scan point clouds that aim to capture liquefaction-induced building settlement, building-ground interactions, and ground deformations. Coverage: İskenderun, Hatay; Gölbaşı, Adıyaman; and Antakya, Hatay (Turkey). DesignSafe files it as a "field recon" project. Keywords: Lidar, earthquake sequence, liquefaction, Iskenderun, Kahramanmaras, ground deformation. Published 2024-09-06. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
